Use case: precise-object-edit.
Image 1 is the exact approved Mina dragon illustration to REPAIR, not redesign.
The user requests an anatomical and transparency correction. Preserve the existing design.

REPAIR 1: TWO ACTUAL ALPHA HOLES INSIDE THE RIGHT WING.
The source PNG has erroneous transparent regions INSIDE the continuous wing membrane, even though their hidden RGB can make the preview appear painted. On its 1536x1024 canvas the largest erroneous internal alpha holes have these bounds:
- x867-1062, y257-548 (large triangular inner membrane bay of the raised/image-right wing).
- x768-925, y433-536 (adjacent smaller inner bay near the back of the head).
These are WING MEMBRANE, NOT openings or gaps. Restore both with solid opaque midnight-navy membrane, matching adjacent colors and shading. Preserve their existing painted surface and blue/white edging. All membrane surfaces between the wing fingers must be fully opaque with alpha255, including dark shadows. Never treat dark paint as background. No transparent triangular panels, tears, holes or partially transparent highlights inside either wing. Keep genuinely exterior empty spaces transparent, including the spaces below scalloped wing edges and between the tail and body. Only antialiased outer silhouette edges may have intermediate alpha.

REPAIR 2: MIRROR THE UPPER RIGHT CLAW, KEEP THE LOWER LEFT ONE.
The small ivory-tipped curved claw above the bow on the image-LEFT wing points toward the image RIGHT, i.e. inward toward the character.
Its counterpart on the high image-RIGHT wing is currently ALSO pointing to the image right. That is anatomically inconsistent.
Change ONLY the high/right wrist claw above its blue-diamond bow into the MIRRORED counterpart: its root stays connected to the same wrist around x770,y95, and the hooked pointed ivory tip curves to the image LEFT, inward toward the image center. Approximate new tip x690,y35. Remove the old right-pointing hook at x850-915,y15-45 completely, including its dark base silhouette; do not leave a second spur or horn there. One inward-curving claw on each wrist, mirror-matched thickness, curved shape, ivory-tip coverage and proportion. The left claw remains untouched. There must be EXACTLY one claw per wing wrist.
Do NOT mirror/rotate either whole wing. Keep their established asymmetrical wingbeat posture. Only the small right wrist claw direction changes.

LOCK EVERYTHING ELSE:
Same huge wing silhouette except that claw, same navy bow/blue-jewel placement, same white scalloped/frilled edging and pale-blue wing line patterns, current blue-black/navy color treatment and fine anime rendering, same black fringe, blue eye, face expression and head size, short sturdy body, two arms and two legs, and same long curved tail ending in the large blue diamond. Do not increase white, add ornaments or change body proportions. Keep the large terminal tail gem exactly as is.

OUTPUT: ONE repaired sprite, same 1536x1024 landscape composition, entire silhouette visible. REAL clean transparent-alpha exterior; fully OPAQUE character and wing interiors. No colored haze or gradient background, no ghost texture outside silhouette, no text, no extra characters. Inspect both wing membranes and the two opposite inward-pointing wrist claws before finalizing.

Edit the provided Mina dragon. Preserve its exact pose, proportions, coloring, wing decoration, face, ribbons and tail jewel. Both wrist claws already point inward correctly: do not change either claw.

REPAIR THIS SPECIFIC VISUAL DEFECT: The small triangular opening in the raised right wing just behind the character's head MUST BE FILLED WITH DARK NAVY WING MEMBRANE. This triangle is at x769-924, y433-536 on the 1536x1024 canvas, center x844,y475. It is immediately above the small scalloped white frill behind the head. Make it an unbroken solid navy web between the black wing ribs and the white frill, matching the navy web directly to its upper-right. There must NOT be a triangular window/opening there. The white frill must be attached to solid navy membrane, not a floating disconnected strip. All other wing panels must also be solid, not see-through.

Place the complete dragon on a PERFECTLY FLAT SOLID CHROMA GREEN (#00FF00) background. This is an OPAQUE RGB production plate. Green only OUTSIDE the silhouette and in genuine open spaces beneath the scalloped wing edges. NO GREEN inside the repaired triangle or other wing membranes. NO TRANSPARENCY, NO checkerboard, NO cloudy gradient, NO smoke or glow. Clean edges. Preserve the approved character design exactly otherwise. Keep the same 1536x1024 landscape framing. One character, no text.

Use case: precise-object-edit. The input is the approved Mina dragon on a flat bright-green production background. Repair TWO TINY REMAINING GREEN HOLES inside the lower/left wing membrane beneath the chin. This is strictly a local paint repair.

On the 1536x1024 canvas:
1. Small triangular green patch centered at x495,y597, bounds x473-530,y587-619, directly BELOW the chin and ABOVE the tiny white scalloped trim of the left wing. Fill with solid midnight NAVY membrane.
2. Adjacent green triangle centered at x560,y599, bounds x534-583,y576-636, directly under the jaw between the neck and the narrow dark wing rib. This also should be solid midnight NAVY membrane behind the head, not an open hole.
Paint both tiny triangles as continuous navy wing material, matching nearby wing shadows. Keep the white scalloped edging, chin silhouette, neck silhouette, black wing ribs and all outlines intact. No green should remain inside these two triangles. The filled panels lie BEHIND the character, so do not paint over the face or neck.

Preserve every other part exactly, especially the already repaired solid right-wing panels, inward-pointing wrist claws, all wing patterns, pose, colors, body, ribbons and the long tail ending in the large blue gem. Do not change design or proportions. Keep the genuine gap between tail and body green, and ALL background outside the actual silhouette flat pure green. Output the SAME opaque 1536x1024 green-background plate, no transparency, no checkerboard, no glow, no new objects. Only the two specified tiny green patches become navy.

postprocessing.scope: Background removal only; no character drawing or shape edits
